༄༅/ /gza' rnams kyi yum zhes bya ba'i gzungs bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// gza' rnams kyi yum zhes bya ba'i gzungs bzhugs so//

༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ gra ha mā tri ka nā ma dha ra ṇi/ bod skad du/ gza' rnams kyi yum zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das 'brog gnas kyi grong khyer chen po na/ lha dang*/ klu dang*/ gnod sbyin dang*/ srin po dang*/ dri za dang*/ lha ma yin dang*/ nam mkha' lding dang*/ mi 'am ci dang*/ lto 'phye chen po dang*/ bdud dang*/ nyi ma dang*/ zla ba dang*/ mig dmar dang*/ pa sangs dang*/ phur bu dang*/ gza' lhag pa dang*/ spen pa dang*/ sgra gcan 'dzin dang*/ mjug ring rnams dang*/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad la sogs pa mang po rnams kyis bstod pa/ rdo rje chen po'i dam tshig gi byin gyis brlabs kyis/ rdo rje'i khri la bzhugs so// byang chub sems dpa' du ma dang yang thabs gcig ste/ 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rje dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje gtum po dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje sde dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rje gzhu can dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje bdag po dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje'i rgyan dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje'i 'od dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu gzigs dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'jig rten dpal dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pad+ma'i tog dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zhal ras rgyas pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pad+ma'i snying po dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pad+ma'i spyan dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'jam dpal gzhon nu dang*/

byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun rnams kyis bskor zhing mdun gyis bltas pa la chos ston to// bkod pa chen po'i rgyan gyi nor bu zhes bya ba thog mar dge ba dang*/ bar du dge ba dang*/ tha mar dge ba dang*/ don bzang po dang*/ tshig 'bru bzang po/ ma 'dres pa/ yongs su dag pa/ yongs su byang ba'i chos ston to// de nas phyag na rdo rjes 'khor de dag la bltas te/ langs nas rang gi rdzu 'phrul gyi byin gyis brlabs kyis/ bcom ldan 'das la lan brgya stong du mar bskor ba byas te/ phyag 'tshal nas spyan sngar 'dug ste/ bsnyems pa dang bcas pas skyil mo krung legs par bcas nas/ 'khor de dag la 'gying bag tu bltas te/ rdo rje'i thal mo rang gi snying gar bzhag nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to// bcom ldan 'das gza' mi bzad pa dang*/ mi bzad pa'i gzugs can/ drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa/ khro ba khro ba'i gzugs can dag sems can thams cad la 'tshe bar bgyid pa/ mtho 'tshams par bgyid pa/ mdangs 'phrog par bgyid cing*/ kha cig nor zas 'phrog par bgyid/ kha cig srog 'phrog par bgyid/ sems can tshe ring ba kha cig ni thung ngur bgyid do// de ltar sems can thams cad la gnod cing 'tshe bar bgyid pa de rnams kyi slad du/ bcom ldan 'das kyis chos kyi rnam grangs gang gis sems can thams cad la bsrungs bar 'gyur pa bshad du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang yang khyod kyis snying rje bskyed pas sems can thams cad la phan par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ gsang chen bas kyang ches gsang ba de bzhin gshegs par zhu bar byed pa legs so legs so// de'i phyir legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zungs shig dang*/ gza' mi bzad pa'i gzugs can shin tu khro ba dang*/ shin tu 'jigs par byed pa rnams kyis mchod pa dang*/ mchod yon dang bzlas brjod bzang po gsang ba bas kyang ches gsang ba ngas bshad do// de dag mchod pas mchod gyur cing*// gnod pa byas na gnod byed dang*// gza' de kun gyi kha dog dang*// ji ltar dga' bar 'gyur ba dang*// lha rnams dang ni lha min dang*// mi 'am ci dang klu dag dang*// gnod sbyin rnams dang srin po dang*/

mi rnams dang ni mi ma yin// drag po gzi brjid chen po dang*// khros pa zhi bar byed pa de'i// gsang sngags rnams dang mchod pa dang*// rim pa bzhin du bshad par bya// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa nyid kyi thugs ka nas snying rje rnam par rol pa zhes bya ba'i 'od zer bkye ste/ gza' rnams kyi spyi bor zhugs so// de nas de'i mod la nyi ma la sogs pa'i gza' thams cad langs te/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa la lha rdzas kyi mchod pa rnams kyis mchod pa byas te/ phyag 'tshal nas pus mo btsugs nas thal mo sbyar ba byas te/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to// bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis bdag cag la sman yon btags par gyur to/ bcom ldan 'das kyis chos kyi rnam grangs gang gis bdag cag rnams la sogs pa chos smra ba rnams la bsrung bar 'gyur ba dang*/ yongs su bskyab pa dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ bde legs su 'gyur ba dang*/ mtshon cha spang ba dang*/ chad pa spang ba dang*/ dug gzhil ba dang*/ dug bsad pa dang*/ mtshams bcad pa dang*/ sa bcing ba rnams bgyid par 'gyur ba bshad du gsol// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas gza' rnams la mchod pa dang*/ gsang sngags bka' stsal to// oṃ me gha la ka lā ya swā hā/ oṃ shi taṃ sha bai swā hā/ oṃ rak+ta a ga ku mā rā ya swā hā/ oṃ bud+dha ya swā hā/ oṃ bṛ ha sba ta ye swā hā/ oṃ su rod ta mā ya swā hā/ oṃ kṛṣ+ṇā bar+ṇa ye swā hā/ oṃ a mṛ ta bri yā ya swā hā/ oṃ dzo ti ke ta bai swā hā/ lag na rdo rje 'di dag ni gza' dgu'i gsang sngags kyi snying po bklags pas grub pa yin te/ kha dog dang mthun par spos kyi dkyil 'khor sor bcu gnyis pa byas pa'i dbus su mchod par bya'o// kham pa'am zangs la sogs pa'am/

gser dang dngul gyi snod du mchod yon phul nas/ re re la yang bzlas brjod brgya rtsa brgyad bya'o// lag na rdo rje de'i 'og tu gza' rnams kyi yum zhes bya ba'i gzungs kyi gsang sngags kyi tshig lan bdun brjod par bya'o// de nas gza' rnams thams cad srung bar byed par 'gyur ro// dbul ba'i gdon thams cad las thar bar 'gyur ro// tshe zad pa las tshe ring por byed par 'gyur ro// lag na rdo rje dge slong dang*/ dge slong ma dang*/ dge bsnyen dang*/ dge bsnyen ma dang*/ gzhan yang sems can kyi rigs gang yin pa dang*/ gang dag gi rna lam du grags pa de dag kyang dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i dus byed par mi 'gyur ro// phyag na rdo rje gza' rnams kyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su mchod par byas te/ nyin gcig bzhin du klog par byed pa'i chos smra ba gang yin pa de la gza' thams cad bdag nyid kun gyi bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed par 'gyur ro// de dang rigs gcig pa rnams kyi dbul ba yang sel bar byed do// de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas gza' rnams kyi yum zhes bya ba'i gzungs bka' stsal pa/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo// pad+ma'i 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo// bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'i gza' rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyu skar rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// gza'i khyim bcu gnyis po rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// tad+ya thā/ bud+dhe bud+dhe/ badz+re badz+re/ pad+me pad+me/ sa ra sa ra/ pra sa ra pra sa ra/ sma ra sma ra/ kṝ ḍā ya kṝ ḍā ya/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ mar+dha ya mar+dha ya/ gha ṭa ya gha ṭa ya/ sarba bigh+nāṃ/ ku ru ku ru/ tshin dha tshin dha/ k+ṣa pa ya k+ṣa pa ya/ shān+te shān+te/ dān+te dān+te/ dha ma ya dha ma ya/ bcom ldan 'das ma bdag nyid du bstan du gsol/ bdag 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ sems can thams cad la srung du gsol/ srung du gsol/

gza' thams cad dang*/ rgyu skar rnams kyi gnod pa bzlog tu gsol/ bcom ldan 'das ma rdzu 'phrul chen po mnga' ba/ sdang ba'i sems can rnams bsal du gsol// bdag gi sdig pa rnams bskam du gsol/ tsaṇa ḍe tsaṇa ḍe/ tu ru tu ru/ tsaṇa ḍe ni tsaṇa ḍe ni/ mu yu mu yu/ mu tsu mu tsu/ ba ha ba ha/ u gre u gre ta me/ pu ra ya me/ ma no ra thāṃ pu ra ya/ sarba ta thā ga tā a dhiṣ+ṭhī te/ sa ma ye swā hā/ oṃ swā hā/ hūṃ swā hā/ hrīḥ swā hā/ dh+ruṃ swā hā/ dh+riṃ swā hā/ pad+ma dhā ra swā hā/ a dhī d+ya ye swā hā/ so mā ya swā hā/ dhā ra ṇi sū tā ya swā hā/ bud+dha ya swā hā/ bri haspa ta ye swā hā/ shu krā ya swā hā/ kṛṣ+ṇā bar+ṇa ye swā hā/ ra ha bai swā hā/ kā ta bai swā hā/ bud+dha ya swā hā/ badz+ra dha rā ya swā hā/ pad+ma dha rā ya swā hā/ ku mā rā ya swā hā/ sarba gra h+ye bh+yaḥswā hā/ sarba nak+ṣa tre bh+yaḥswā hā/ sarba dwa di sha rā sha ni bh+yaḥswā hā/ sarba u ba dra ba swā hā/ oṃ sarba bi d+ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ phyag na rdo rje 'di ni gza' rnams kyi yum zhes bya ba'i gzungs kyi gsang sngags kyi tshig dngos grub thams cad kyi gzhi yin no// phyag na rdo rje gang yang gza' rnams kyi gzungs kyi gsang sngags kyi tshig 'di dag ston zla tha chung yar gyi ngo'i tshes bdun nas brtsams te gso sbyong dang ldan par byas te/ tshes bcu bzhi'i bar du gza' rnams la mchod pa byas te gzung bar bya'o// de nas zla ba nya'i nyin mtshan thog mtha' bklags na/ de dag lo dgu bcu rtsa dgu'i bar 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa mi 'byung ngo*// gza'i 'jigs pa dang*/ skar mda' lhung ba dang*/ zla ba dang rgyu skar gyi gnod pas 'jigs par mi 'gyur ro// tshe rabs dran par 'gyur ro// gza' thams cad la mchod pa byas par 'gyur ro// gza' thams cad kyis ci 'dod pa sbyin par byaid do// de nas bcom ldan 'das la gza' rnams kyis phyag 'tshal te/
legs so legs so zhes gsol te mi snang bar gyur to// gza' rnams kyi yum zhes bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs so/// /
